operation: Follow the actual configured DamageScene prefabs. Restore native transforms/RectTransforms, TMP fields and original font/material identities, single-outline TMPEffect, localized text, full clip bindings, sorting, camera scale, lifetime, height and scene offset. Reuse existing native assets only when their raw official identities match.
cache_policy: Read the original APK first. A retained current cloud file is reusable only when its bytes satisfy the requested 854 manifest MD5 and size plus its own source-receipt SHA256. Changed bundles are never substituted.
derived_font_cache: The shared dynamic font may cache the original localized words using the already-bound official FZY4K TTF. Glyph outlines and metrics are generated from that exact font; no replacement font or artwork is introduced.
disperse_notification: User-confirmed local wiring: emit once when one disperse operation removes at least one status. Probability failure or no removable status emits nothing. This supplies the missing server call to FightDisperseModification, not a recovered server implementation.
